source: I can accept a delay if you explain the reason and the new timeline.
target: A delay I can accept, if you explain its cause and the new timeline.
references: A delay I can accept, if you explain its cause and the new timeline.
source_meaning: I can accept a delay if you explain the reason and the new timeline.

source: First-time user ko guide chahiye, obstacle course nahi.
target: The process must be made simpler for those attempting it for the first time.
references: The process must be made simpler for those attempting it for the first time.
source_meaning: We need to make the process simpler for someone doing it for the first time.

source: I want us to learn from the failure instead of hiding it.
target: Let us learn from this failure rather than conceal it. What is hidden teaches nothing.
references: Let us learn from this failure rather than conceal it. What is hidden teaches nothing.
source_meaning: I want us to learn from the failure instead of hiding it.

source: Estimate confirm nahi hua. Date promise karna abhi premature hai.
target: No date can be promised until the team confirms its estimate.
references: No date can be promised until the team confirms its estimate.
source_meaning: We cannot promise a date until the team confirms the estimate.

source: I need the freedom to question the plan without being labelled negative.
target: I must be free to question the plan without being branded negative. Doubt is not disloyalty.
references: I must be free to question the plan without being branded negative. Doubt is not disloyalty.
source_meaning: I need the freedom to question the plan without being labelled negative.

source: Incomplete data hai toh label karo. Guesswork ko certainty mat banao.
target: If the information is incomplete, we must say so plainly.
references: If the information is incomplete, we must say so plainly.
source_meaning: If the information is incomplete, we should say so clearly.

source: I will stand by you, but I won't lie for you.
target: I will stand beside you. I will not lie for you. Loyalty has its limits.
references: I will stand beside you. I will not lie for you. Loyalty has its limits.
source_meaning: I will stand by you, but I won't lie for you.

source: Facts ek side. Assumptions doosri. Mix karoge toh picture blur hogi.
target: Let us separate what we know from what we merely assume.
references: Let us separate what we know from what we merely assume.
source_meaning: Let's separate what we know from what we are assuming.

source: A good solution should still work when the original expert is unavailable.
target: A worthy solution must still hold when its original expert is absent. Strength that rests on one person is no strength at all.
references: A worthy solution must still hold when its original expert is absent. Strength that rests on one person is no strength at all.
source_meaning: A good solution should still work when the original expert is unavailable.

source: Preferred outcome alag hai. Fair outcome zyada important.
target: I seek a fair outcome, even if it is not the one I hoped for.
references: I seek a fair outcome, even if it is not the one I hoped for.
source_meaning: I want a fair outcome, even if it is not the outcome I hoped for.

source: Inspector aane tak original seal ko mat todna.
target: Leave the original seal intact until the inspector arrives.
references: Leave the original seal intact until the inspector arrives.
source_meaning: Keep the original seal intact until the inspector arrives.

source: If Leo is late again, start the meeting without him.
target: Should Leo be late again, begin the meeting without him.
references: Should Leo be late again, begin the meeting without him.
source_meaning: If Leo is late again, start the meeting without him.

source: Mujhe original file chahiye, screenshot nahi.
target: I need the original file, not a screenshot of it.
references: I need the original file, not a screenshot of it.
source_meaning: I need the original file, not a screenshot of it.

source: We have saved 18,000 rupees, but the repair will cost 22,000.
target: We have saved eighteen thousand rupees. The repair will cost twenty-two thousand.
references: We have saved eighteen thousand rupees. The repair will cost twenty-two thousand.
source_meaning: We have saved 18,000 rupees, but the repair will cost 22,000.

source: Spare medicine kisi aur ko mat dena.
target: Give the spare medicine to no one else.
references: Give the spare medicine to no one else.
source_meaning: Do not give the spare medicine to anyone else.

source: Once the guests arrive, please serve the food.
target: Once the guests arrive, serve the food.
references: Once the guests arrive, serve the food.
source_meaning: Once the guests arrive, please serve the food.

source: Engine ne woh awaaz phir ki toh main mechanic ko call karunga.
target: If the engine makes that sound again, I will summon the mechanic.
references: If the engine makes that sound again, I will summon the mechanic.
source_meaning: I will call the mechanic if the engine makes that noise again.

source: The blue folder belongs to Sana, while the green one is mine.
target: The blue folder is Sana's. The green one is mine.
references: The blue folder is Sana's. The green one is mine.
source_meaning: The blue folder belongs to Sana, while the green one is mine.

source: Main 2:20 wali train le sakta hoon, 2:05 wali nahi.
target: I can take the two-twenty train. Not the two-oh-five.
references: I can take the two-twenty train. Not the two-oh-five.
source_meaning: I can take the 2:20 train, but not the 2:05 one.

source: Please ask Farah before using her laptop.
target: Ask Farah before you use her laptop.
references: Ask Farah before you use her laptop.
source_meaning: Please ask Farah before using her laptop.

source: Water filter ka cartridge har chhe mahine mein badalna hota hai.
target: The water filter demands a new cartridge every six months.
references: The water filter demands a new cartridge every six months.
source_meaning: The water filter needs a new cartridge every six months.

source: I did not receive the parcel that was marked delivered yesterday.
target: The parcel marked delivered yesterday never reached me. The record does not match the truth.
references: The parcel marked delivered yesterday never reached me. The record does not match the truth.
source_meaning: I did not receive the parcel that was marked delivered yesterday.

source: Dono parents agree nahi karte toh school trip ka form submit nahi ho sakta.
target: Unless both parents consent, the school trip form cannot be submitted.
references: Unless both parents consent, the school trip form cannot be submitted.
source_meaning: Unless both parents agree, the school trip form cannot be submitted.

source: The technician will arrive between 11 am and noon.
target: The technician will arrive between eleven in the morning and noon.
references: The technician will arrive between eleven in the morning and noon.
source_meaning: The technician will arrive between 11 am and noon.

source: Galat document bhejne se behtar hai ek din wait kar loon.
target: I would rather wait a day than send the wrong document. Haste is the greater risk.
references: I would rather wait a day than send the wrong document. Haste is the greater risk.
source_meaning: I would rather wait one day than send the wrong document.
